EKAlarm.doc: A class that represents an alarm.

EKCalendar.doc: A class that represents a calendar in EventKit.

EKCalendarItem.doc: An abstract superclass for calendar events and reminders.

EKEvent.doc: A class that represents an event in a calendar.

EKEventStore.doc: An object that accesses a person’s calendar events and reminders and supports the scheduling of new events.

EKObject.doc: An abstract superclass for all EventKit classes that have persistent instances.

EKParticipant.doc: A class that represents person, group, or room invited to a calendar event.

EKRecurrenceDayOfWeek.doc: A class that represents the day of the week.

EKRecurrenceEnd.doc: A class that defines the end of a recurrence rule.

EKRecurrenceRule.doc: A class that describes the pattern for a recurring event.

EKReminder.doc: A class that represents a reminder in a calendar.

EKSource.doc: An abstract superclass that represents the account a calendar belongs to.

EKStructuredLocation.doc: A class that specifies a geofence to activate the alarm of a calendar item.

EKVirtualConferenceDescriptor.doc: Details about a virtual conference that uses a custom room type.

EKVirtualConferenceProvider.doc: An object that associates virtual conferencing details with an event object in a user’s calendar.

EKVirtualConferenceRoomTypeDescriptor.doc: Details about a room where virtual conferences take place.

EKVirtualConferenceURLDescriptor.doc: Details about how users join a virtual conference, including a title and URL.

EKAlarmProximity.doc: A value indicating whether an alarm is triggered by entering or exiting a region.

EKAlarmProximityEnter.doc: The alarm is set to fire when entering a region.

EKAlarmProximityLeave.doc: The alarm is set to fire when leaving a region.

EKAlarmProximityNone.doc: The alarm has no proximity trigger.

EKAlarmType.doc: A value that specifies what type of action occurs when the alarm triggers.

EKAuthorizationStatus.doc: The current authorization status for a specific entity type.

EKAuthorizationStatusAuthorized.doc: The app can access the service.

EKAuthorizationStatusDenied.doc: The person explicitly denied access to the service for the app.

EKAuthorizationStatusFullAccess.doc: The app has both read and write access to the requested entity type.

EKAuthorizationStatusNotDetermined.doc: The person hasn’t chosen whether the app may access the service.

EKAuthorizationStatusRestricted.doc: The app isn’t authorized to access the service.

EKAuthorizationStatusWriteOnly.doc: The app has write-only access to the requested entity type.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityMask.doc: A bitmask indicating the event availability settings that the calendar can support.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityBusy.doc: The calendar supports the busy event availability setting.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityFree.doc: The calendar supports the free event availability setting.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityNone.doc: The calendar does not support event availability settings.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityTentative.doc: The calendar supports the tentative event availability setting.

EKCalendarEventAvailabilityUnavailable.doc: The calendar supports the unavailable event availability setting.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a calendar event availability mask with the specified raw value.

EKEntityMask.doc: A bitmask of EKEntityType for specifying multiple entities at once.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates an entity mask with the specified raw value.

EKEntityType.doc: The type of entities allowed for a source.

EKEventAvailability.doc: The event’s availability setting for scheduling purposes.

EKEventAvailabilityBusy.doc: The event has a busy availability setting.

EKEventAvailabilityFree.doc: The event has a free availability setting.

EKEventAvailabilityNotSupported.doc: Availability settings are not supported by the event’s calendar.

EKEventAvailabilityTentative.doc: The event has a tentative availability setting.

EKEventAvailabilityUnavailable.doc: The event has an unavailable availability setting.

EKParticipantRole.doc: The participant’s role for an event.

EKParticipantRoleChair.doc: The participant is the chair of the event.

EKParticipantRoleNonParticipant.doc: The participant does not have an active role in the event.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusCannotDeliver.doc: The invitation wasn’t delivered because the system is unsure of how to deliver it.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusDelivered.doc: The invitation has been sent and successfully delivered.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusDeliveryFaile.doc: The invitation wasn’t delivered due to a temporary failure.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusNoPrivileges.doc: The invitation wasn’t delivered because of insufficient privileges.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusNone.doc: The invitation hasn’t been sent yet.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusPending.doc: The invitation is in the process of being sent.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusRecipientNotA.doc: The invitation wasn’t delivered because scheduling with the participant isn’t allowed.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusRecipientNotR.doc: The invitation wasn’t delivered because the source doesn’t recognize the recipient.

EKParticipantScheduleStatusSent.doc: The invitation has been sent, but it’s unclear if it was successfully delivered.

EKParticipantStatus.doc: The participant’s attendance status for an event.

EKParticipantStatusAccepted.doc: The participant has accepted the event.

EKParticipantStatusDeclined.doc: The participant has declined the event.

EKParticipantStatusDelegated.doc: The participant has delegated attendance to another participant.

EKParticipantStatusInProcess.doc: The participant’s event is currently in process.

EKParticipantStatusPending.doc: The participant has yet to respond to the event.

EKParticipantStatusTentative.doc: The participant’s attendance status is tentative.

EKParticipantStatusUnknown.doc: The participant’s attendance status is unknown.

EKReminderPriorityNone.doc: The reminder has no priority set.

EKSourceTypeCalDAV.doc: Represents a CalDAV or iCloud source.

EKSpan.doc: An object that indicates whether modifications should apply to a single event or all future events of a recurring event.

EKSpanFutureEvents.doc: Modifications to this event instance should also affect future instances of this event.

EKSpanThisEvent.doc: Modifications to this event instance should affect only this instance.

+alarmWithAbsoluteDate:.doc: Creates and returns an alarm with an absolute date.

+alarmWithRelativeOffset:.doc: Creates and returns an alarm with a relative offset.

+calendarForEntityType:eventStore:.doc: Creates a new calendar that can contain the given entity type.

+calendarWithEventStore:.doc: Creates and returns a calendar belonging to a specified event store.

-addAlarm:.doc: Adds an alarm to the receiver.

-addRecurrenceRule:.doc: Adds a recurrence rule to the recurrence rule array.

-removeAlarm:.doc: Removes an alarm from the calendar item.

-removeRecurrenceRule:.doc: Removes a recurrence rule from the recurrence rule array.

+eventWithEventStore:.doc: Creates and returns a new event belonging to a specified event store.

-compareStartDateWithEvent:.doc: Compares the start date of the receiving event with the start date of another event.

-refresh.doc: Updates the event’s data with the current information in the Calendar database.

+authorizationStatusForEntityType:.doc: Determines the authorization status for the given entity type.

-calendarItemWithIdentifier:.doc: Locates a reminder or the first occurrence of an event with the specified identifier.

-calendarItemsWithExternalIdentifier:.doc: Locates all reminders or the first occurrences of all events with the specified external identifier.

-calendarWithIdentifier:.doc: Locates a calendar with the specified identifier.

-calendarsForEntityType:.doc: Identifies the calendars that support a given entity type, such as reminders or events.

-cancelFetchRequest:.doc: Cancels the request to fetch reminders.

-commit:.doc: Commits all unsaved changes to the event store.

-defaultCalendarForNewReminders.doc: Identifies the default calendar for adding reminders to, as specified by user settings.

-enumerateEventsMatchingPredicate:usingB.doc: Finds all events that match a given predicate and calls a given callback for each event found.

-eventWithIdentifier:.doc: Locates the first occurrence of an event with a given identifier.

-eventsMatchingPredicate:.doc: Finds all events that match a given predicate.

-fetchRemindersMatchingPredicate:complet.doc: Fetches reminders that match a given predicate.

-initWithAccessToEntityTypes:.doc: Initializes access to the event store with support for the given entity type.

-initWithSources:.doc: Creates an event store that contains data for the specified sources.

-predicateForCompletedRemindersWithCompl.doc: Creates a predicate to identify all completed reminders that occur within a given date range.

-predicateForEventsWithStartDate:endDate.doc: Creates a predicate to identify events that occur within a given date range.

-predicateForIncompleteRemindersWithDueD.doc: Creates a predicate to identify all incomplete reminders that occur within a given date range.

-predicateForRemindersInCalendars:.doc: Creates a predicate to identify all reminders in a collection of calendars.

-refreshSourcesIfNecessary.doc: Pulls new data from remote sources, if necessary.

-removeCalendar:commit:error:.doc: Removes a calendar from the event store by either committing or batching the changes.

-removeEvent:span:commit:error:.doc: Removes an event or recurring events from the event store by either committing or batching the changes.

-removeEvent:span:error:.doc: Removes an event from the event store.

-removeReminder:commit:error:.doc: Removes a reminder from the event store by either committing or batching the changes.

-requestAccessToEntityType:completion:.doc: Prompts the person using your app to grant or deny access to event or reminder data.

-requestFullAccessToEventsWithCompletion.doc: Prompts people to grant or deny read and write access to event data.

-requestFullAccessToRemindersWithComplet.doc: Prompts people to grant or deny read and write access to reminders.

-requestWriteOnlyAccessToEventsWithCompl.doc: Prompts the person using your app to grant or deny write access to event data.

-reset.doc: Reverts the event store to its saved state.

-saveCalendar:commit:error:.doc: Saves a calendar to the event store by either committing or batching the changes.

-saveEvent:span:commit:error:.doc: Saves an event or recurring events to the event store by either committing or batching the changes.

-saveEvent:span:error:.doc: Saves changes to an event permanently.

-saveReminder:commit:error:.doc: Saves changes to a reminder by either committing or batching the changes.

-sourceWithIdentifier:.doc: Locates an event source with the specified identifier.

-refresh.doc: Merges changes to this object with the latest saved values.

-reset.doc: Returns this object to its saved state.

-rollback.doc: Rolls back the property values of this object to its original state when it was first fetched.

-ABPersonInAddressBook:.doc: Returns the address book record that represents the participant.

-ABRecordWithAddressBook:.doc: Returns the address book record that represents the participant.

+dayOfWeek:.doc: Creates and returns a day of the week with a given day.

+dayOfWeek:weekNumber:.doc: Creates and returns an autoreleased day of the week with a given day and week number.

-initWithDayOfTheWeek:weekNumber:.doc: Initializes and returns a day of the week with a given day and week number.

+recurrenceEndWithEndDate:.doc: Initializes and returns a date-based recurrence end with a given end date.

+recurrenceEndWithOccurrenceCount:.doc: Initializes and returns a count-based recurrence end with a given maximum occurrence count.

-initRecurrenceWithFrequency:interval:da.doc: Initializes and returns a recurrence rule with a given frequency and additional scheduling information.

-initRecurrenceWithFrequency:interval:en.doc: Initializes and returns a simple recurrence rule with a given frequency, interval, and end.

+reminderWithEventStore:.doc: Creates and returns a new reminder in the given event store.

-calendarsForEntityType:.doc: Returns the calendars that belong to this source object that support a particular entity type.

+locationWithMapItem:.doc: Creates a new structured location with the specified map item.

+locationWithTitle:.doc: Creates a new structured location with the specified title.

-initWithTitle:URLDescriptors:conference.doc: Creates an object that describes a virtual conference, including a name and URL to join the conference.

-fetchAvailableRoomTypesWithCompletionHa.doc: Provides an array of room types where events take place.

-fetchVirtualConferenceForIdentifier:com.doc: Provides details about a virtual conference that takes place in a room the user selects.

-initWithTitle:identifier:.doc: Creates an object that describes a location where a virtual conference takes place.

-initWithTitle:URL:.doc: Creates a URL descriptor with the given title and URL.

allowsContentModifications.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can add, edit, and delete items in the calendar.

hasAttendees.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the calendar item has attendees.

location.doc: The location associated with the calendar item.

notes.doc: The notes associated with the calendar item.

recurrenceRules.doc: The recurrence rules for the calendar item.

timeZone.doc: The time zone for the calendar item.

title.doc: The title for the calendar item.

allDay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the event is an all-day event.

availability.doc: The availability setting for the event.

birthdayPersonID.doc: The Address Book framework record identifier of the person for this birthday event.

isDetached.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether an event is a detached instance of a repeating event.

organizer.doc: The organizer associated with the event.

startDate.doc: The start date of the event.

EKEventStore.EventStoreChanged.doc: A notification posted when changes are made to the Calendar or Reminders database.

defaultCalendarForNewEvents.doc: The calendar that events are added to by default, as specified by user settings.

delegateSources.doc: The event sources delegated to the person using your app.

eventStoreIdentifier.doc: The unique identifier for the event store.

sources.doc: An unordered array of objects that represent accounts that contain calendars.

hasChanges.doc: Returns whether this object or any of the objects it contains has uncommitted changes.

currentUser.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether this participant represents the owner of this account.

participantRole.doc: The participant’s role in the event.

weekNumber.doc: The week number of the day of the week.

occurrenceCount.doc: The occurrence count of the recurrence end, or 0 if the recurrence end is date-based.

calendarIdentifier.doc: The identifier for the recurrence rule’s calendar.

daysOfTheMonth.doc: The days of the month associated with the recurrence rule, as an array of NSNumber objects.

daysOfTheWeek.doc: The days of the week associated with the recurrence rule, as an array of EKRecurrenceDayOfWeek objects.

daysOfTheYear.doc: The days of the year associated with the recurrence rule, as an array of NSNumber objects.

monthsOfTheYear.doc: The months of the year associated with the recurrence rule, as an array of NSNumber objects.

recurrenceEnd.doc: Indicates when the recurrence rule ends.

setPositions.doc: An array of ordinal numbers that filters which recurrences to include in the recurrence rule’s frequency.

weeksOfTheYear.doc: The weeks of the year associated with the recurrence rule, as an array of NSNumber objects.

completed.doc: A Boolean value determining whether or not the reminder is marked completed.

dueDateComponents.doc: The date by which the reminder should be completed.

startDateComponents.doc: The start date of the task.

sourceIdentifier.doc: A unique identifier for the source object.

sourceType.doc: The type of this source object.

title.doc: The name of this source object.

radius.doc: A minimum distance from the core location that would trigger the alarm or reminder.
